name: before-you-build
tagline_zh: 写代码前先花10分钟查风险：需求、定位、收费、留存、信任、分发、采用，七项全检。别人只问“能不能做”。
tagline_en: Before you code, run a 10-min risk check: demand, positioning, pricing, retention, trust, distribution, adoption.
desc_en: Pre-build product and feature risk review for founders, product managers, and AI-assisted builders. Use this skill when the user is about to build a landing page, MVP, SaaS product, internal tool, agent workflow, or major feature and needs to check demand, positioning, monetization, retention, trust, distribution, and adoption risk before implementation starts.
why_zh: 同类工具只列清单，它把风险按阶段排序，并给出可操作的缓解动作，让创始人直接照做。
why_en: Unlike generic checklists, it prioritizes risks by stage and pairs each with concrete mitigation steps—ready for founders to.
